name: Thermal protection
summary: A thermal protection function for a documented machine or transformer application.
description: A thermal protection function responds to a thermal condition or model appropriate to the selected machine or transformer application. Its inputs and implementation vary between devices, so the number alone does not establish a sensor arrangement or a thermal model.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify whether the device uses measured temperature, electrical inputs or another documented implementation.
Link the function to the protected equipment and manufacturer documentation.
distinction: A thermal relay, temperature sensor and instantaneous overcurrent element are different devices or functions.
